# Skills Repository
The skills repository is the peer's local skill and plugin workspace.

## Location and Scale
- Local path D:\repository\skills on origin/main.
- Contains 16 skills and 8 dsh plugins.

## Linked Skills
- zentao-analyzer at D:\repository\skills\zentao-analyzer, with cached download zentao_file.py.
- worktree-snapshot, submodule-commit, and session-handoff are linked.
- session-handoff restored Junction on 2026-11-25.

## Unlinked Skills
- cursor-model-routing, memory-migration-archive, openviking-autostart, and vite-build-profiler are not linked.

# DSH Agents Guidelines
dsh/AGENTS.md defines the screenshot-inline verification gate used by the peer.

## Verification Gate
- dsh/AGENTS.md:7 sets the screenshot inline verification gate.
- Five self-checks must be completed before inlining screenshots.

## Path Rules
- Inline screenshot paths must be locked to $env:TEMP.
- Paths must use forward slashes and angle brackets, with timestamp-based naming.
- Relative paths and attachments paths are forbidden.

# Deploy Env Dashboard
The deploy-env dashboard is a deployment environment board maintained by the peer.

## Core Configuration
- Runs on port 18098 with a SQLite registry.
- Uses nginx sites and proxy as a single source of truth.
- Provides five environment slot views; registry.sqlite is git-tracked.
- conf_path_for prefers env-sites and falls back by display_name, project, project_key, and listen port.

## Credentials Registry
- Credentials database holds 34 env rows across two tables plus a password_plain column.
- Ten slash-style mismatched references were corrected to canonical viking format.
- Five historical accounts were added: 2 admin, 2 business test, and 1 fdc-v3 local.

## Privacy Database
- Privacy database entries deploy_env-pwd-county, deploy_env-pwd-fangxun, and deploy_env-pwd-super can decrypt plaintext.

# DSH Web Orchestration
DSH Web is a multi-model orchestration system used by the peer.

## Architecture
- Uses LangGraph and Magpie for multi-model orchestration.
- Planner pool uses gpt-6-luna and gpt-5.4-mini in a three-level chain.

## Model Configuration
- From 2026-11-24, config.yaml changed 15 deepseek ids to hy4flash-free (10 workbuddy, 5 auto).
- The changes load per request without a restart.
- router.py peak-time skip strategy automatically becomes a no-op.

# DSH Toolchain
The dsh toolchain is a set of utilities maintained by the peer.

## Tools
- cost-meter: bigMissStreak>=2, perStepUncachedBudget=10000, stepReminderThreshold=120.
- plan-gate: git three-state interception plus _review.json validation.
- solve-captcha.mjs: defaults to auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash.
- concise-report: produces a three-part report.

## Status
- Toolchain facts were last confirmed on 2026-11-16.

# Agent Guard
agent-guard is a guard component in the peer's environment.

## Drift Checking
- exploration-drift is warn-only and only records accounting.

## Verification Loop
- verify-loop uses agentBrowserMax 12 and Start-Sleep 5, accumulating per session without reset.
- On 2026-11-24 it was downgraded from block to warn.
- The change requires a web restart to take effect in new sessions.

# Web Presets
Web presets control tool-workflow availability in the peer's web environment.

## Tool Workflow
- preset-standard disables tool-workflow.
- preset-cordis and preset-full-tools still enable tool-workflow.

## Skill Directory
- The skill directory has 40 items, with dsh-harness-dev-context disabled.
- Each step carries a fixed context of about 14.6k tokens.

# OpenViking
OpenViking is the memory system used by the peer, with a plugin and scheduled audit task.

## Plugin and Startup
- dsh-memory-plugin provides profile-inject injection and proactive retrieval.
- Startup script and watchdog are at C:\Users\Administrator\.openviking\ (git repo on master, no remote configured so cannot push; back up to .bak before changes).
- From 2026-11-25, two LLM entries switched to hy4flash-free primary with hy4flash points fallback.

## Memory Store
- The memory library holds about 6585 entries, pure Markdown with no frontmatter.
- URIs follow viking://user/default/memories/{entities,preferences,_archive}/...
- ov CLI v0.5.5 supports ls -r, read, write, set-tags, glob, and --output json.
- The Python SDK has no top-level exports, so scripts can only use the CLI.

## Scheduled Audit
- A daily 08:30 memory audit task schedule-e31f1263-6af2-4270-9031-b04f4a795ce9 is active with target=new; next run is 2026-11-26 08:30.
